text:
mike.g: Planning a weighted DNS shift for apac edge on Thu 11:30 UTC. Goal: 10% traffic to ap-southeast initially, then 30% after 15m, then 100% if green. Who can own smoke checks?

jen.k: I can take initial smoke checks and monitor latency dashboards. What's the exact DNS record and TTL?

mike.g: Record: edge.redwood-inference.internal (CNAME -> rwd-gw.global). We'll apply weights via Route53 TrafficPolicy. Temp TTL = 30s during the cut, revert to 300s after stabilization. I'll push infra change at 11:20 UTC. deploy-bot will post the change id.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued: dns-weighted-shift-1770456789. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/changes/872. Triggered by mike.g

aj: I'll be oncall for rollback. Suggested rollback criteria: >2% error rate or p50/p95 latency regression >500ms sustained for 5m. Rollback plan: set APAC weight back to 0% and restore TTL to 300s, then confirm global health.

todd: Reminder: update egress ACLs for ap-southeast2 so our probes can hit the new edge IPs. I can apply at 11:15.

jen.k: Smoke checklist (short):
- `curl -sS https://edge.redwood-inference.com/health` -> expect 200 and small payload
- 5 sample generation requests against the model route, p95 latency target <900ms
- check traces in APM for tail latencies and error traces
I'll post pass/fail here.

mike.g: Also run these commands for routing confirmation:
```
dig +short edge.redwood-inference.internal @8.8.8.8
curl -H "Host: edge.redwood-inference.com" https://<apac-gw-ip>/v1/ping
```

ops-bot: Watchman alerting updated for this rollout: baseline p95=450ms. New thresholds: alert if p95>800ms or error_rate>1.5%. Notifications -> #eng-oncall and #eng-platform.

jen.k: 11:30: initial 10% applied. Running checks now.

jen.k: health OK, sample gen p95=420ms, 0 errors in sample. APM traces look nominal. :thumbsup:

mike.g: 11:45: ramping to 30%.

aj: Noticed p95 bump to ~510ms for a small subset of requests, error rate still <0.5%. Keeping an eye.

mike.g: 12:00: rolling to 100%.

todd: Firewall ACL confirmed applied earlier, no blocked connections seen.

jen.k: Full traffic checks passed. I'll continue monitoring for 30m and post any anomalies.

aj: Rollback window open until 12:40. If anything crosses thresholds I'll trigger the revert and notify here.

mike.g: Thanks all. Merging infra PR and updating runbook note about TTL step.

mike.g: PR merged: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/changes/872/merge
